description: REQ-BILL-009 requires verifying 'used = false' on the PAY.JP token before proceeding. The PayjpToken interface in shell/types.ts (line 12-18) has no 'used' field, and the subscribe orchestration in shell/subscribe.ts (lines 103-115) never checks the 'used' property. The contract's grading dimension 1 ('Spec Fidelity') does not call out this specific check. The 3DS verification is present but token-used verification is entirely absent from implementation, tests, and contract criteria.
remediation: Add 'used: boolean' to PayjpToken interface. Add a guard in subscribe.ts after fetchToken that rejects with 422 when payjpTokenData.used === true. Add a test case for this scenario. Add a contract criterion explicitly requiring token-used check verification.
